--- a/crates/typst/src/foundations/str.rs
+++ b/crates/typst/src/foundations/str.rs
@@ -178,24 +178,60 @@ impl Str {
 
     /// Extracts the first grapheme cluster of the string.
     /// Fails with an error if the string is empty.
+    ///
+    /// If a `pattern` is given, returns the first grapheme cluster that
+    /// matches it instead. Fails with an error if none does.
     #[func]
-    pub fn first(&self) -> StrResult<Str> {
-        self.0
-            .graphemes(true)
-            .next()
-            .map(Into::into)
-            .ok_or_else(string_is_empty)
+    pub fn first(
+        &self,
+        /// A character class to search for: `{"alpha"}`, `{"numeric"}`,
+        /// `{"alphanumeric"}`, `{"uppercase"}`, `{"lowercase"}` or
+        /// `{"whitespace"}`. A grapheme cluster matches if its first
+        /// character belongs to the class. If omitted, the very first
+        /// grapheme cluster is returned.
+        ///
+        /// ```example
+        /// #"123abc".first(pattern: "alpha")
+        /// ```
+        #[named]
+        pattern: Option<Str>,
+        /// The case to transform the grapheme cluster into: `{"upper"}`,
+        /// `{"lower"}` or `{"title"}`. If omitted, the grapheme cluster is
+        /// returned unchanged.
+        #[named]
+        case: Option<Str>,
+    ) -> StrResult<Str> {
+        let grapheme = pick_grapheme(&self.0, pattern.as_deref(), false)?;
+        apply_case(grapheme, case.as_deref())
     }
 
     /// Extracts the last grapheme cluster of the string.
     /// Fails with an error if the string is empty.
+    ///
+    /// If a `pattern` is given, returns the last grapheme cluster that
+    /// matches it instead. Fails with an error if none does.
     #[func]
-    pub fn last(&self) -> StrResult<Str> {
-        self.0
-            .graphemes(true)
-            .next_back()
-            .map(Into::into)
-            .ok_or_else(string_is_empty)
+    pub fn last(
+        &self,
+        /// A character class to search for: `{"alpha"}`, `{"numeric"}`,
+        /// `{"alphanumeric"}`, `{"uppercase"}`, `{"lowercase"}` or
+        /// `{"whitespace"}`. A grapheme cluster matches if its first
+        /// character belongs to the class. If omitted, the very last
+        /// grapheme cluster is returned.
+        ///
+        /// ```example
+        /// #"hello123".last(pattern: "numeric")
+        /// ```
+        #[named]
+        pattern: Option<Str>,
+        /// The case to transform the grapheme cluster into: `{"upper"}`,
+        /// `{"lower"}` or `{"title"}`. If omitted, the grapheme cluster is
+        /// returned unchanged.
+        #[named]
+        case: Option<Str>,
+    ) -> StrResult<Str> {
+        let grapheme = pick_grapheme(&self.0, pattern.as_deref(), true)?;
+        apply_case(grapheme, case.as_deref())
     }
 
     /// Extracts the first grapheme cluster after the specified index. Returns
@@ -835,6 +871,28 @@ fn string_is_empty() -> EcoString {
     "string is empty".into()
 }
 
+/// Transforms a grapheme cluster into the requested case, if any.
+fn apply_case(grapheme: &str, case: Option<&str>) -> StrResult<Str> {
+    Ok(match case {
+        None => grapheme.into(),
+        Some("upper") => grapheme.to_uppercase().into(),
+        Some("lower") => grapheme.to_lowercase().into(),
+        Some("title") => to_title_case(grapheme).into(),
+        Some(other) => bail!("unknown case option \"{}\"", other),
+    })
+}
+
+/// Uppercases the first scalar value and lowercases the rest.
+fn to_title_case(grapheme: &str) -> EcoString {
+    let mut chars = grapheme.chars();
+    let mut out = EcoString::new();
+    if let Some(first) = chars.next() {
+        out.extend(first.to_uppercase());
+        out.push_str(&chars.as_str().to_lowercase());
+    }
+    out
+}
+
 /// A regular expression.
 ///
 /// Can be used as a [show rule selector]($styling/#show-rules) and with
@@ -949,6 +1007,78 @@ cast! {
     },
 }
 
+/// A built-in class of characters that `first` and `last` can search for.
+#[derive(Debug, Copy, Clone, Eq, PartialEq)]
+enum GraphemeClass {
+    Alpha,
+    Numeric,
+    Alphanumeric,
+    Uppercase,
+    Lowercase,
+    Whitespace,
+}
+
+impl GraphemeClass {
+    /// Looks up a class by the name the user wrote.
+    fn parse(name: &str) -> StrResult<Self> {
+        Ok(match name {
+            "alpha" => Self::Alpha,
+            "numeric" => Self::Numeric,
+            "alphanumeric" => Self::Alphanumeric,
+            "uppercase" => Self::Uppercase,
+            "lowercase" => Self::Lowercase,
+            "whitespace" => Self::Whitespace,
+            _ => bail!(
+                "unknown pattern \"{}\" (expected \"alpha\", \"numeric\", \
+                 \"alphanumeric\", \"uppercase\", \"lowercase\" or \"whitespace\")",
+                name
+            ),
+        })
+    }
+
+    /// Whethe
